findings.title: R-2 cannot keep the duel canonical array byte-identical
findings.claim: R-2 adds canonical ship-slot and missile-owner data while requiring the duel's canonical array, hash and golden to remain byte-identical.
findings.why: Today's missile slots encode no owner or ship-active flag. The new pool needs an owner because its slot no longer identifies the firing ship. Serializing these fields changes the array.
findings.fix: Specify a compatibility serialization for the two-ship duel that preserves the old array, or make R-2 a schema migration with an appropriate equivalence proof and new golden.

findings.title: The R-3 and R-4 migration comparisons include a field that must change
findings.claim: Both proofs compare every retained or old canonical field while requiring a SIM_VERSION bump.
findings.why: SIM_VERSION is the first canonical field. The stated comparisons cannot pass across the required bump.
findings.fix: Explicitly exclude or normalize the version field in both migration comparisons, while checking that the new version has the intended value.

findings.title: The R-6 privacy assertion rejects its own exterior summary
findings.claim: The projection always publishes rival room damage levels, but the privacy test forbids every field of a rival interior unless that interior is visible.
findings.why: Room damage is an interior field, so a correct unlocked projection would fail the stated test.
findings.fix: Define an explicit public exterior-field allowlist and assert that no other rival interior fields or RNG state reach any channel without visibility.
